ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the collector ingested this record into MAAS

reportName.description: Name of the source metrics report the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder path of the source metrics report file

name.description: Metric name from the OData 'Name' property

timestamp.description: Metric timestamp from the OData 'Timestamp' property

metric_type.description: Metric type from the OData 'MetricType' property

counter.description: Metric counter value from the OData 'Counter' property

interface_name.description: Name of the source LTA metrics interface (e.g. metrics_LTA_Werum)

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service providing the metrics (e.g. Werum)

modification_date.description: Date the metric record was last modified
